articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation for Ships Detection from Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Ships detection, as well as other object detection, and localization tasks in satellite images are the central problems in the field where remote sensing and computer vision coalesce. They are commonly used in different areas like environment monitoring, fishery management, logistics, insurance and many others. This paper provides an approach based on the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) as the main algorithm/instrument for detecting ships in optical satellite images of different spatial resolution. For achieving the best performance, we divided the problem into stages, which gave a possibility to control the quality of intermediate outcomes. The proposed method contains two parts: 1) building a classifier based on XCeption, 2) using baseline Unet model with Resnet18 as encoder for exact segmentation which allow us to achieve accuracy of more than 84%.

articleTitle: Processing of Redundant Information in Airborne Electronic Systems by means of Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Processing of redundant information of the noncollinear measuring instrument developed by the technology of microelectromechanical systems is considered. The algorithm of information processing based on neural networks is proposed. The structural schemes of neural networks for single axis and triaxial inertial sensors are given. The neural network with one hided layer for information processing of noncollinear redundant measuring instrument based on inertial sensors is represented. The features of information processing algorithm are described. A process of a training process is represented. Results of information processing by means of neural networks are given. The obtained results can be useful for improving information used for navigation of moving vehicles of the wide class.

articleTitle: Assessment Reliability of Data in the Identification Friend or Foe Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In the presented work, on the basis of the introduced integral indicator of the quality of information support for decision makers in the Air Traffic Control system, the security of the Identification Friend or Foe systems was assessed under the action of intentional simulated interrogation signals flows in the interrogation channel. It is shown that jamming of intentional correlated interference of the required intensity in the interrogation channel allows paralyzing the aircraft responder of Identification Friend or Foe systems, which reduces the likelihood of correct identification of air objects and, as a result, eliminates the accuracy of information in the Air Traffic Control system.

Author Keywords: probability of detection of air objects

articleTitle: Comparative Quality Analysis of the Air Objects Detection by the Secondary Surveillance Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative quality analysis of the air objects detection of the Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR). Two structures for processing the coordinate codes of response signals, taking into account the effect of the aircraft responder availability factor, are compared. The impacts of fluctuation and impulse noise in the response channel also are taken into account. It is shown that the processing of received signals of the coordinate code with preliminary inter-period processing is more preferable, being compared with the current subsequent inter-period processing of the coordinate code. The quality of detection of air objects is improved by reducing the influence of fluctuation and impulse noise in the response channel.

articleTitle: Capacitive Distance Sensor With Coplanar Electrodes for Large Turbogenerator Core Clamping System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper present two type capacitive sensors with coplanar electrodes for core clamping system power accumulators. The sensor measures the compression ratio of the stator core as the deformation of a special elastic element. The capacitive measurement method for setting sensors under clamping nut has advantages over other methods due to high metrological characteristics and influenced of sensors to electromagnetic, magnetic fields industrial frequency and temperature of grounded surface and other. Approximating functional dependences for a coplanar capacitive sensor with the same angular width of electrodes are obtained using the methods of regression analysis. To reduce the effect of parasitic capacitance from edge effects, it has been proposed to use electrodes with different angular widths of electrodes with high and low potential for the sensor.

articleTitle: Ice Crystals Microscopic Images Segmentation Based on Active Contours
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Ice recrystallization is one of the most well-known processes which involved in long term storage of living cells. In this paper, we propose an image processing steps for ice crystal segmentation using active contours. Based on the described steps we develop related software, which should improve quality of microscopic analysis for better understanding of ice recrystallization process. The developed application has been successfully applied for semi-automated segmentation and analysis of ice crystals during isothermal annealing.

articleTitle: Anti-Aliasing Filter in Digital Control System for Converter with Active Power Filter Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Anti-aliasing filters used to exclude mixing spectra in systems with digital signal processing. Electric power converters, especially active power filters, with digital control system are hard real-time systems. Such systems apply additional restrictions to the response of anti-aliasing filters. The paper defines features of the use of anti-aliasing filters in power converter systems and shows some sources of control errors. The requirements to the characteristics of filters, depending on the spectral composition of the input signal have been formulated. In paper given mathematical modeling results of the most common types of anti-aliasing filters from point of view to influence to digital control systems.

articleTitle: Quality Assessment of Synchronization Devices in Telecommunication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This paper represents analysis of principles providing maximally reliable delay estimation of signal synchronization devices in telecommunication. Clock synchronization schemes on the base of stochastic models, graph-analytic interpretation, analytical functional description and their parameters selection in case of real complex hindrance are analyzed. Dependences between dispersion of maximally reliable estimation of synchronization devices and signal to noise ratio (SNR) are represented. Analytical expressions and dependences are obtained for deviation of synchronization error with respect to SNR at the output of discriminator. Diagrams of state are formed for assessment of digital synchronization device in case of error state. Average slip time of synchronization is calculated with respect to SNR.

articleTitle: Features of Image Segmentation of the Upper Respiratory Tract for Planning of Rhinosurgical Surgery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Analysis of data of the SCT of the upper respiratory tract is the basis not only for the diagnosis, but also for the subsequent computer planning of rhinosurgical surgeries. For this, the process of automated segmentation of the anatomical structures of the nasal cavity is necessary, which significantly simplifies the preparation of geometric data for subsequent biophysical modeling. Segmentation of anatomical objects in this area should be carried out in two stages: selection of areas by density threshold values, subsequent marking of detected objects and post-processing -to eliminate artifacts and degenerate objects using morphological processing and logical filtering according to the geometric features of the analyzed objects. The arising segmentation errors are eliminated by the expert in an interactive mode.

articleTitle: Pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks for the Lung Sounds Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This article discusses the use of pre-trained sophisticated architectures of convolutional neural networks for the classification of lung sounds. The classification was made on the basis of the spectrogram of lung sound signals. The images of the spectrograms were analyzed directly, a set of parameters was obtained, on the basis of which the neural networks were trained. As the results show, the proposed classification method can serve as a good auxiliary tool for making a diagnosis to help the pulmonologist.

articleTitle: Transistor Switches Quasi-Control in Quasi-Resonant Pulse Converters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Features of zero current and zero voltage switching quasi-resonant pulse converters control are analyzed in this paper. Ways to reduce dynamic losses in transistor switches are described. Reasons for changing parameters of currents and voltages in resonant circuits of these converters, as a result of which their resonance frequency changes, and consequences of this fact are justified. Principles of transistor switch automatic quasi-control are considered, whereby simplifies to synthesize of control systems and reduces dynamic losses in it.

articleTitle: Modeling of Energy Spectrum of Acoustic-emission Signals in Dynamic Deformation Processes of Medium with Microstructure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental research of the energy spectrum of acoustic emission signals of the model of forerunners of deformation processes in media with a microstructure are presented. The laws governing changes in the oscillatory properties of acoustic emission signals during the destruction of the structure of materials under load are established. The existence of a relationship between changes in the spectral characteristics and the moments of occurrence of acoustic emission signals with the parameters of the force field at various stages of deformation is proved. An explanation of the causal relationships of the occurrence of acoustic emission signals with defects in the microstructure is given. The results obtained make it possible to watch the dynamics of the development of defects and to provide prediction of the state of materials.

articleTitle: The Heat Exchange Simulation In The Device For Measuring The Emissivity Of Coatings And Material Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The simulation of heat exchange in the working chamber of the device for measuring emissivity was carried. It was shown that the simulation results coincide well with the experimental results. Established that, with the selected technical parameters, the contribution of the conductive-convective component of heat exchange does not exceed 0.1% of the radiation component, and therefore the measurement can be carried out without vacuuming the working chamber. Found suitable area for measurement of emissivity with unevenness of the heat flux distribution, which does not exceed ± 2%.

articleTitle: Quadrotor Design for Outdoor Air Quality Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Air quality has direct impact on the human health. Its high pollution levels can cause health problems. So, it is highly important to monitor air quality to prevent environmental pollution and improve human quality of life. In environmental applications, one of the most promising directions is measurements with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The use of UAV has great interest due to their advantages over ground vehicles like high maneuverability and easy deployment. The main scope of this study, is to present a custom UAV design capable to perform environmental monitoring missions. While in computational fluid dynamics simulations was investigated UAV's propulsion system influence on gas measurement solution placement.

articleTitle: The Model of the Glycemic Level Self-Regulation for Extracting the Information From the Glucose Tolerance Tests Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper provides a brief critical review of the original mathematical models of the carbohydrate exchange regulation system from historically first works to its most advanced model. Their significant deficiencies were mentioned. To eliminate them, it was carring out the construction of the most minimal, but the universal, structural and functional mathematical model of this physiological system, for the program-model extraction of the diagnostic information from the glycemic data of the glucose tolerance tests. The model presents itself a differential equation of the first order with delayed argument relative to the glycemic level in the periphery, through which all the significant factors of the carbohydrate exchange regulation are expressed, including insulin. This model is convenient for numerical analysis, in which it ultimately reduces to a simple recurrent formula. A definite physiological sense was given to the parameters of this model. This model firstly universally describes the dynamics of glycemia with arbitrary exogenous glucose load under the standard oral and intravenous glucose tolerance tests, as well as under the oral glucose tolerance test with double load, according Staub - Tragott. At that, the new model for the first time describes the well-known phenomenon of insulin suppression of the second rise of the normal glycemic level.

articleTitle: Elimination of Electric Arc Stabilization in Precision Welding with High-Current DC Glow Discharge
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The article considers the possibility of increasing stability of DC high-current glow discharge in the diffusion bonding processes at discharge currents 1 - 30 A and the gas pressure 1.33 - 13.3 kPa by replacing the monolithic anode with a multi-section one with the mobile anode sections. It is shown that the application of proposed devices which provides an increasing in the length of the inter-electrode gap to the values of 0.03 - 0.06 m during 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> - 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> sec is an effective way of extinguishing electric arcs arising from disturbing of the high-current glow discharge in welding and brazing.

articleTitle: Rivne City Land Cover and Land Surface Temperature Analysis Using Remote Sensing Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A large number of Ukrainian cities faced the problem of the lack of reliable apparat for ecological condition and it's greenery monitoring. Remote Sensing data give's the opportunity to provide reliable information in real conditions for a large area on a regular basis. This approach is applicable throughout the world and was used on the Public initiative "Trees with stories in Rivne", a study that includes the analysis of the condition of urban trees, city land surface temperature, planning and comparison with the city of Lublin. To solve this problem satellite Sentinel-2 images were used to build land cover classification maps and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), satellite images of Landsat-8 used to build land surface temperature maps and increase the time series of vegetation index by 2014. The analysis showed poor condition of green plantations, high summer average temperature of the land surface and deterioration of these indicators.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Sounds by Acoustic Hearing Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: It is shown that the transient evoked otoacoustic emission in response to a short (broadband) sound impulse is an impulse function of the auditory canal, middle ear, and cochlea of the inner ear. Its form corresponds to the basic functions form of wavelet representations of the "convexity" type, which are characterized by a shift (delay) in time, position and shift of position. It is established that the division into frequency groups, which is the main property of hearing, does not occur in the central nervous system, as previously thought, but in an acoustic auditory analyzer. It is a correlation filter with many inputs - transverse fibers and exits of the outer hair cells to the nerve fibers. The acoustic system of the acoustic analyzer is a unique correlation filter, i.e. a kind of patent of nature.

Author Keywords: resonant frequencies of the middle ear
formula for the middle ear norm parameter

articleTitle: Hardware Accelerators for IOTA Cryptocurrency
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: IOTA cryptocurrency is a distributed solution for secure messaging and micropayments between Internet-of Things devices. The authors introduced open source hardware accelerators for Curl hash function and proof-of-work computations to increase the processing rate of IOTA transactions. The structure and operation principle of both accelerators are described. Proposed accelerators have been implemented on FPGA and integrated into ARM-based System-on-Chip. The characteristics of the system have been evaluated. Compared to official software implementation the proposed hardware accelerators demonstrate x2100 speed up on the creation of IOTA transactions.

articleTitle: Protection of NdFeB Magnets by Multilayer Coating
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The Cu/(Ni-Cu) multilayer coating is proposed for rare-earth magnets protection. The influence of architecture of Cu/(Ni-Cu) multilayer coating on porosity, corrosion resistance and internal stresses is shown. The surface of the coatings have globular structure. The internal stress of multilayer coatings with microhardness of 520-670 HV is 160- 175 MPa for coatings of 10 μm thickness, that is lower than internal stress of nickel coatings. The coatings are non-porous at the 2-3.7 μm thickness, depending on the architecture of the multilayer coating. High corrosion resistance of Cu/(Ni-Cu) multilayer magnets is shown.

articleTitle: Smart City Services for Kiev City Within ERA-PLANET SMURBS Project
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The SMURBS/ERA-PLANET project ("SMartURBan Solutions for air quality, disasters and city growth") is one of the projects of ERA-NET`s transnational call and falls under Strand 1 "Smart Cities and Resilient Societies". SMURBS project combines Earth Observation expertise and smart city methods to address several urban environmental pressures. One of these is the urban agglomerations' growth (SMURBS UG). This trend is very important, since the growth processes of cities around the world and in Europe have intensified recently and it is crucial to assess the current situation and ensure a high quality of life in such an environment through the use of "smart" technologies and offering support to informed decision making. Within this papers the preliminary results of creation of Urban Atlas product for Kyiv city with use of free satellite imagery are described.

articleTitle: Determination of the Incoherent Scatter Signal Statistical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Methodological features of the determination of the incoherent scatter signal statistical characteristics are considered. The variants of the receiving-processing channel structures are analyzed taking into account the specifics of the incoherent scatter radar. Under the proposed method of I/Q demodulation, digital signal samples are formed in quadrature dependence as a result of analog-to-digital conversion directly and they are accordingly used in the subsequent signal processing. It enables estimating the quadrature components of the autocorrelation function (ACF) of the incoherent scatter signal using one channel of the radio receiver and ADC and eliminating a number of drawbacks of an analog I/Q demodulator. The coherence of the incoherent scatter radar operation is ensured by the formation of clock pulses for the ADC from the signal of the radar synthesizer. A method of correlation processing is proposed. Due to the increase in the frequency of analog-to-digital signal conversion, the number of ACF ordinates on the correlation interval length (ACF argument) is increased. This makes it possible to reduce errors of estimation of the signal autocorrelation function and consequently errors of ionospheric parameters determination for different heights of the ionosphere.

articleTitle: Rapid Prototyping Station for Batteries-Supercapacitors Hybrid Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper, the rapid prototyping station (RPS) for a hybrid energy storage system based on batteries and supercapacitors is presented. Main requirements to the functional capabilities and control features of experimental installation have been formulated with respect to state-of-the-art trends and, according to them, the RPS structure is designed. The concept of experimental testing and designed prototyping system can be used for implementation of different control algorithms and power management strategies for electric vehicles, renewable energy and smart grids applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Estimation Errors of the Fifth and Sixth Order Cumulants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: silicon; nanofabrication; elemental semiconductors; nanoparticles; nanostructured materials; X-ray diffraction; medical image processing; nanoelectronics; III-V semiconductors; diseases.

articleTitle: Objective Audiometry Based on the Formula of the Middle Ear Parameter: A New Technique for Researches and Differential Diagnosis of Hearing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The proposed technique of objective (without patient's participation) audiometry allows measuring hearing loss. It is based on a developed model of a middle ear, obtained with its model the formula for a individual middle ear norm parameter. On the basis of the formula the resonant coefficients of transformation of pressure through ossicles and amplification of pressure in auditory meatus are designed.

Author Keywords: resonant frequencies of the middle ear
formula for the middle ear norm parameter

articleTitle: Metal-Assisted Chemical Etching of Silicon for Photovoltaic Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Silicon nanowires were obtained by means of metal-assisted chemical etching of silicon wafer. In this work, the effect of Ag-NP deposition time and etching time of silicon on the surface morphology, reflection spectra and photovoltaic characteristics of solar cells was studied. It was found that a maximum values of a short-circuit current (up to 29 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and an open circuit voltage (up to 546 mV) has obtained under etching time of 30 min and Ag-NP deposition time of 40 s.

articleTitle: Power Supply of Resistance Welding Machine with Reactive Power Compensation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: An approach to application of power supplies for resistance welding machines based on three-to-one matrix converter as reactive power compensator is offered. By setting a predetermined phase shift of the input current, it is possible to achieve reactive power compensation also for the consumer demand. The range of variation of the possible compensation angles is limited by the electromagnetic compatibility standards for the boundary current harmonic levels. Proposed control system is simulated using MATLAB. The simulation results confirmed high effectiveness of proposed approach.

articleTitle: Estimation of Radio Source Movement Parameters Based on TDOA- and RSS- Measurements of Sensor Network in Presence of Anomalous Measurements
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Widespread application to determination of radio sources location using wireless sensor networks is found by methods Based on TDOA- and RSS- measurements. In real conditions, it is often becomes necessary to consider existence of anomalous measurement results, which lead to divergence of traditional Kalman filtration algorithms of radio sources movement parameters. In work on the basis of a mathematical apparatus of the mixed Markov processes in discrete time quasi-optimal estimation algorithm of radio source movement parameters with complex use TDOA- and RSS- measurements of the sensor network, sustainable to anomalous measurement errors are synthesized. For the considered example, by means of statistical modeling, the developed estimation algorithm allows recognizing the appearance of anomalous measurement errors with a probability close to unit and eliminate their influence on the accuracy of determination of radio sources movement parameters.

articleTitle: Improving the Method of Interference Holography to Determine the State of Plasma Membranes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Due to the fact that blood in the human body plays a crucial role for the flow of vital metabolic processes -the study of red blood cells is of great scientific and medical interest. This is due to the fact that the erythrocyte morphology has changes not only in hematological diseases, but also reflects the state of the organism as a whole. The paper proposed a technical solution that uses the method of holographic interferometry to obtain a three-dimensional image of human erythrocytes. The paper also suggests optimization of the formation of the reference and object beam of rays in the device, which significantly improved its technical and economic characteristics.

articleTitle: Visually Lossless Compression of Dental Images
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: It has become a standard practice to use images in medicine. Due to increasing resolution, their size often occurs to be large and, then, necessity to compress them efficiently before storage and/or transmission arises. Since compression ratio of lossless compression is frequently limited, one has to apply lossy compression. Then, a problem of providing an acceptable quality to retain diagnostic value of compressed data appears. This paper deals with analyzing opportunities to perform this in non- iterative way for dental medical images for two versions of a coder based on discrete cosine transform (DCT) - AGU and AGU-M. It is demonstrated that mean squared error (MSE) and MSE modified with taking into account peculiarities of human vision system (MSEHVS) of distortions due to lossy compression can be predicted before starting compression itself. Then, a desired quantization step (QS) for AGU or scaling factor (SF) for AGU-M can be adjusted to provide a desired quality. Regression uses statistics of alternating current (AC) DCT coefficients calculated in 300...500 8x8 pixel blocks to predict output metrics using fitting curves in preliminary obtained scatter-plots.

articleTitle: The Method of Increasing the Detection Range of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles In Multiradar Systems Based on Surveillance Radars
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper analyses a model of a small base synchronous multiradar system on the basis of two-coordinate surveillance radar, which will enable to increase the detection range of unmanned aerial vehicles. Separate positions of elements of such systems are spacious apart from each other, but the processing of radar information is carried out in a single point. A special feature will be the using of radars with mechanical rotation in the azimuth plane as elements of the system. It will increase the efficiency of detection due to the using of radar information contained in the structure of the electromagnetic field more efficiently than the monostatic two-coordinate radars. The advantage will be an increasing in the energy potential of the system as a result of the addition of the power of the pulses of individual radars and an increasing in the gain of the antenna array due to the more directional properties of the antenna array compared to single antenna. Calculations of the multiradar system parameters are carried out by the method of mathematical modelling.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Storage System of Power Supply for Micro Resistance Welding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This paper proposes a high-efficiency energy storage system within the micro resistance welding device based on battery-supercapacitor semi-active hybrid topology. A SEPIC converter is considered for power distribution between energy storages in order to improve the Li-ion battery performance in terms of cycle life and to increase the efficiency of the overall energy storage system. A comprehensive analysis of energy storage system losses has shown that the efficiency of the proposed topology is 92% at the target switching frequency of 100 kHz. Finally, the theoretical analysis is validated by simulation results, which illustrate the supercapacitor charging process and voltage and current traces of the SEPIC converter individual components.

articleTitle: Message-level Decoding of Error Patterns for Turbo-Product Codes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper we present message-level approach for decoding of Turbo-Product codes that uses indirect evidences about errors positions in the received message. It adds additional step into the decoding flow that corrects erroneous bits by the end of full iteration. The additional step results in the improvement of decoder ability to correct error patterns that is difficult to correct using only half-iterations. We consider specific error patterns that happen during decoding procedure and demonstrate how the method can be applied or if another method is necessary for such cases. The approach is oriented to be implemented on hardware platforms (e.g. Field-Programmable Gate Array) basis and reckon limitations of this integrated circuit type.

articleTitle: Influence of Sizes and Sides Ratio of Rectangular Screen on Directive Patterns of Vertical Dipole
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Based of the uniform geometrical diffraction theory method an asymptotic solution is obtained for the 3D vector problem of diffraction of the field of a vertical half-wave dipole placed above a rectangular metal screen. A substantial acceleration of the calculation of the patterns of such radiating system is achieved by using the obtained asymptotic expressions for geometric optics field and edge wave field. The fast-active developed software for the patterns computing are used for the detailed study of the physical peculiarities of the radiation field formation and the search of the influence of the screen sides ratio and the dipole to screen distance on the patterns. The reliability of calculations and the delimitation of applicability of the developed software are investigated by comparing with the patterns calculated using Feko software.

articleTitle: Two–Stage Segmentation of SAR Images Distorted by Additive Noise with Uncorrelated Samples
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper the algorithm of SAR images segmentation is investigated, which is developed on the basis of two-stage approach the essence of which is in conducting of one-dimensional processing independently along rows and columns followed by combining the obtained results and forming of segmented image. Analysis of the algorithm is performed using simulation while processing of test synthesized image.

articleTitle: The Influence of a Rotating Magnetic Field on the Intensity of Methane Formation in a Bioreactor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The analysis of the physicochemical processes of anaerobic fermentation under the influence of a magnetic field of low frequency is carried out. The results of modeling and laboratory studies of the effect of a rotating magnetic field on a water substrate of animal and vegetable waste are given. Magnetic treatment contributes to the dissolution of carbon dioxide in water, which contributes to an increase in the share of biomentane through the reduction of carbon dioxide with fatty acids. The acceleration of the onset of the maximum yield of biomethane for two days in comparison with the control sample and a significant increase in intensity in the initial period of fermentation were noted.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of the Aharonov-Bohm Effect for Interacting Electrons in Thin Quantum Rings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The electronic states of a InSb, InAs and GaN quantum rings with a small number of interacting electrons in magnetic field by the means of the spin-density functional theory were analysed in detail. It has been shown that Aharonov-Bohm effect highly depends on the number of interacting electrons. The results indicate that in the case of two interacting electrons in the InSb, InAs and GaN ring, these oscillations become aperiodic. Quantum rings of different materials have the different Aharonov-Bohm influence in case of two interacting electrons. The Aharonov-Bohm effect in a InSb, InAs and GaN quantum ring can be regulated by changing the number of interacting electrons.

articleTitle: The Impact of MQTT-based Sensor Network Architecture on Delivery Delay Time
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to present two new architectures of the complexes of embedded systems in the context of the Internet of Things. The proposed new schemes use the MQTT protocol but provide both an autonomous operation and an online mode. This is achieved by adding one additional layer, which consists of its own MQTT-broker and critical messages handler so that in case of the Internet access disappearance, the system could continue to respond to changes. The research of message delivery delays has been carried out for the proposed models. The comparative analysis was conducted to identify the advantages and disadvantages of both solutions.

articleTitle: Methods for Analyzing the Thermal Field of Rod Type Piezoceramic Electroacoustic Transducer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Methods for the analysis of thermal fields for designs of piezoceramic electroacoustic transducers are considered. The causes of the heating emergence, and the negative consequences caused by the heating of the transducers, are analyzed. The necessity of analyzing the thermal fields of piezoceramic electroacoustic transducers of a rod structure is substantiated. Compared the analytical method for finding a thermal field based on solving the Fourier differential heat equation and computer simulation performed using the finite element method in the computer-aided design system SolidWorks. The solution of the heat conduction equation, which corresponds to the formulated boundary conditions, is obtained by replacing the rod transducers with a system of layers. The numerical calculations of thermal fields by the discussed methods for a typical design of a rod piezoceramic transducer are carried out. It was discovered that modeling of thermal fields is easier to implement, it takes into account structural features of converters and allows you to quickly change the parameters of elements to find the most rational design solution. The obtained results can be used when designing piezoelectric electroacoustic transducers.

articleTitle: High Frequency Half-Bridge GaN-Based Pulse Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Pulse generators are widely used for the excitation of ultrasonic transducers in non-destructive testing systems, medical and cosmetic equipment. The paper presents a pulse generator which contained a half-bridge GaN power stage. The device can generate pulses of a minimum duration of 40 ns with a front duration of 5 ns and provides output current up to 25 A. The generator uses a RX switch with bipolar transistors that blocks the input of the measuring device during the generation of the test pulse and does not contribute a signal distortion.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Pre-Processing of Tomographic Images for Segmentation of Paranasal Sinuses
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: It has been established that low-frequency filtering (both standard averaging and Gaussian) allows to suppress high-frequency noise emissions, but it has several disadvantages, the main of which include blurring of object boundaries (their high-frequency components are a useful signal) and low efficiency of impulse noise suppression in comparison with median filtering that completely eliminates local intensity emissions when filter aperture sizes are adapted to their area. As a method of secondary processing of tomographic images during subsequent segmentation of bone structures, the most preferred is the method of median filtration, which has the best indices of the degree of suppression of local interference and preservation of the contour sharpness of anatomical objects, which is important when studying the individual anatomical variability of structures of the upper respiratory tract according to tomographic data.

articleTitle: FIR Filter Design by Micro-Cap Tools
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The purpose of the article is to show possibility of finite impulse response (FIR) filter design in Micro-Cap environment. Fourier series design method is chosen for implementation. Realization of the method is illustrated by an example.

articleTitle: Nanostructures of Cu, Au and In on the Silicon Single Crystal Surfaces at their Thermal Deposition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Formation of gold, copper and indium surface nanorelief in their thermal evaporation on the silicon single crystal surface (the (111) and (110) planes) is investigated using the methods of high-vacuum scanning probe microscopy and spectroscopy with atomic resolution. The main stages of morphological transformation depending on the parameters of deposition are established. The initial stage of the formation of copper nanostructures as well as gold ones has a fractal character. The growth mechanism consists in the formation of conglomerates of nanoparticles with their subsequent transformation into ellipsoidal particles, after which the formation of nanocrystals occurs. The next link in such a chain of transformations is the formation of crystallographic planes. Revealed features of the nanorelief transformation are associated with the size effect. Found that in the case of Si (111) copper and gold form self-ordered hexagonal-pyramidal nanostructures, which consist of atomic growth steps. Growth of the next step begins at 3 nm from the edge of plane. The processes of formation of the electronic structure of copper and gold are caused by an increase in the density of electronic states at the edge of each monoatomic plane. In view of this, growth of each next plane begins not from the edge, but from the specified distance from the edge, which is more energetically favorable. The process of transformation of the density of electronic states curve of In in the region of occupied and unoccupied states (from 2 to -2 eV) is investigated using the methods of tunneling spectroscopy. For the Si (110) plane, only monolayer hexagonal formations of copper and gold are characteristic. In studying the processes of In deposition on Si (111) and (110) surfaces, cluster conservatism and bunches of clusters formation is observed.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Technique for Use in Real-Time Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of creation of new advanced technologies of image enhancement aimed at use in real-time mobile applications. The aim of this work is to increase the efficiency of image contrast enhancement by gray-level transformations. In order to achieve this aim, we propose a new approach to images enhancement based on an estimate of the brightness distribution at the boundaries of objects in the image. To demonstrate this approach proposes a new parameter-free technique of gray-level transformation for adaptive nonlinear image contrast stretching in automatic mode. The results of experimental research using known noreference metrics of contrast confirm the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: 5V wide supply voltage bandgap reference for automotive applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A novel approach for design and simulation method of 5V wide supply voltage bandgap reference circuit for automotive application is presented. The main concept of proposal is to scale down the 5V external source by additional voltage converter and use it to supply the main bandgap reference circuit based on 1.8V tolerant planar CMOS devices. A mixed signal approach with an additional analog circuitry was used. The system is designed in 28nm CMOS technological process and simulated using Synopsys mixed mode simulation tools.

articleTitle: Speech spectrum of the Ukrainian language
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This article has first obtained the spectrum of a speech to the Ukrainian language. The graphs of the spectral power density of the Ukrainian and Russian languages are experimentally determined as related in the Balto-Slavic group. The author's definition of the concept "characteristic spectral points of a language" is proposed. Results of work are necessary at the analysis and recognition of the speech.

articleTitle: Nanotechnological Electrochemiluminescent Transducer for Heterogeneous Detection of 5,6,11,12-tetraphenyltetracene
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This work is devoted to development of the nanotechnological electrochemiluminescent transducer for heterogeneous detection of 5,6,11,12-tetraphenyltetracene as a representative member of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) in water. This method has the advantage of incorporating the analyte into the supramolecular assembly nanolayer on the electrode, and resulted in the increase in the surface concentration of the target analyte as well as lowering the limit of detection. For a rational choice of the amphiphilic matrix for model PAH, quantum chemical calculations were performed to supplement the experimental results. Interestingly, PMMA was found to be the best matrix for the preparation of homogenous supramolecular assembly.

articleTitle: Features of Images Obtained by Examinations of Large Animals on X-Ray Tomosynthesis Units
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: It was proposed the method for evaluating of the digital X-ray tomosynthesis effectiveness during the examination of large animals limbs using a mobile linear X-ray tomography. The joint phantom the with added test objects was used for measurements. It was experimentally confirmed the contrast increasing of the test objects in slices of the tomosynthesis images in 6 - 9 times in comparison with radiographic images. The contrast increasing in a depth indicate about a high efficiency of tomosynthesis.

articleTitle: The Role of Surface Conductivity in Electro-Mechanics of Microparticles in a Meakly-Conducting Dielectric Drop
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In order to simulate motion of microparticles in a weakly-conducting dielectric drop the Taylor's leaky-dielectric model is extended taking into account the interfacial current. Electric-potential distribution inside and outside a weakly-conducting dielectric sphere embedded in a weakly-conducting dielectric in a uniform alternating-current (AC) electric field is determined. The conventional definition of the total, bulk plus surface, conductance of the sphere is detailed allowing for its dependence on the angular distribution of the external electric field. Migration of microparticles over the interface of the drop due to the electrohydrodynamic (EHD) drag and dielectrophoretic (DEP) forces is concluded to depend strongly on the surface conductivities of the drop and individual microparticles. Thus, we show that recent explanation of manipulation by microparticles across the surface of a silicone-oil drop immersed in castor oil is misleading. Allowing for the surface conductivity of the microparticles, we find that EHD drag and DEP forces are of the same direction but not opposite at zero or low frequencies as stated previously. The motion of microparticles turns back because of the reversal of the DEP force with the field frequency. Surface conductivity of the drop can also explain experiments in which the prolate deformation persists after liquids of the drop and ambient media are interchanged.

articleTitle: Simple Acoustic Array for Small UAV Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper proposes the approach to detection of small aerial vehicles by an acoustic array of five microphones. Four microphones in the horizontal plane along the orthogonal direction and are symmetrical to the fifth. Depending on the characteristics of the sound radiation, it is proposed to use correlation or phase detection techniques. The estimation of the angular coordinates of the object is carried out in two stages. First, the arrival sector is established, and then the angle of arrival of the acoustic wave is refined. The proposed approach significantly reduces hardware resources and simplifies the algorithm for processing the received audio signal.

articleTitle: Logic Circuits Based on Neuron-Like Antiferromagnetic Spin Hall Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Neuromorphic computing is field of electronics which use the similar principals as human brain does. Neurons in nervous system can be presented as non-linear oscillators with different regimes of operating. In contradiction to traditional computers neuromorphic systems demonstrate better results in tasks of imaging recognition, tasks of synthesis and predictions. In this paper we show that antiferromagnetic spin Hall oscillator in certain regime can demonstrate behavior similar to the one of a biological neuron. Form of generation pulses, existence of the threshold of driving signal, which divides different operation regimes, and other common features of a spin Hall oscillator and biological neuron gives an opportunity to propose the use of such a generator as a neuron in neuromorphic circuits. Also such artificial "neuron" based on an antiferromagnetic spin Hall oscillator can perform different logical operations. We demonstrate that AND, OR, Majority and Q gates, and full adder operations can be realized on that such "neurons". As single peak duration is several picoseconds, the operation frequency of such neuromorphic systems can be tens of GHz.

articleTitle: Influence of Gas Adsorption on the Impedance of Graphene Oxide
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Graphene oxide (GO) and reduced graphene oxide (rGO) films were formed by ultrasonic spray coating method and were studied by micro-Raman spectroscopy (mRS), current-voltage characteristics and impedance spectroscopy. Raman spectra of GO and rGO films shows two typical peaks, with maxima at ~1350 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> and ~1590 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> (D and G bands). One semicircle on the Nyquist curve of gold/graphene oxide/gold structure suggests the existence of homogeneous regions. Adsorption of ethanol, acetone and isopropyl vapors changes electrical conductivity of graphene oxide films in different way. The sensing mechanisms to the organic vapors are discussed.

articleTitle: Scattering Mechanisms in Arsenide Indium
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The scattering rates of typical scattering mechanisms in indium arsenide were studied. The low-field dependence of the drift mobility of electrons vs temperature is calculated. A set of initial parameters for modeling has been proposed, which provides a satisfactory agreement of the calculated characteristics with the known results.

articleTitle: Nano-Processor for the Small Tasks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The eight-bit stack processor architecture is proposed, which is designed for the FPGA implementation. The microprocessor with this architecture has small hardware costs, reduced software amount, and ability to add up to hundred new user instructions to its instruction set. The microprocessor architecture is adapted for programming the serial port communications and is able to perform the data stream parsing. It is effectively used for the Internet of Things applications.

articleTitle: Interference from Ultra Wide Band Devices on Mobile Service in the Frequency Range of 3400-3800 MHz
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This study is about the influence of ultrawideband noise on subscriber (AS) and base stations (BSs) of the mobile service operating in the range 3400-3800 MHz. Defined minimum security distance for subscriber stations and interference levels at the receiver input for three types of base stations. The following scenarios of the impact of a single interference from the UWB device are considered in the work: influence on the single mobile service subscriber station; impact on micro city base station; impact on macro suburban base station; impact on the macro city base station. The dependence of the level of noise on the input of the receiver of the AS from the separation distance between the ultrawideband device and the subscriber station for cases of single UWB interference to a single subscriber station, the effect of the single UWB interference on the micro city base station has been obtained. In order to assess the interference with the base station, it is necessary to take into account the characteristics of the base stations, namely the height of the suspension, the direction diagram, and the angle of inclination of the antennas in the vertical plane. Before starting, the UWB device must monitor the environment for a minimum amount of time to detect any active receptor interference signal. The results of the study of sharing ultra-wideband devices and the mobile service in the frequency range of 3400-3800 MHz show exceeds protection level of the interference threshold of 5 dB for the macro urban BS for the maximum antenna downtilt.

articleTitle: Duty-Cycle Correction Circuit For High Speed Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: DCC circuit is designed for high speed interfaces such as Universal serial bus (USB) and Peripheral component interconnect express (PCIe). It finds the duty-cycle variations from nominal value by a differential amplifier detection circuit output state and corrects thru the negative feedback loop. The DCC has improved stability, correction range and operating frequency as compared with mixed-signal and all-digital DCCs. For the simulation have been used 14nm FINFET technology, have been implemented CML-CMOS buffer with positive feedback which made attainable the output duty cycle correction to 50 ± 0.05% over the input duty-cycle range of 20-80% for 5-10GHz. 10GHz operating frequency and 0.8 V supply voltage DCC consumes 1.8 mW. The disadvantage of the proposed DCC is settling time increasing by 15% compared to analog feedback DCC without positive feedback CML-CMOS buffer.

articleTitle: Approach for Cardiac Action Potential Detection from Noised Recordings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The morphology of action potential (AP) is a key element in the determination of normal or pathological processes in the cardiac cells and the diagnosis of heart diseases. Therefore obtaining useful information about the shape of AP pulses minimizing the noise contribution is an important task of signal processing to improve the diagnosis process. In this paper a method to detect the APs of cardiomyocytes is proposed, based on wavelet transform, decomposition and reconstruction in eigenvectors basis of cardiac cycles. The parallel conductance model is used to simulate the cardiac AP and ion currents taking into account white or pink noise. Numerical experiments demonstrate the performance of the AP detection for various signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The proposed method can be used to obtain undistorted AP morphologies in order to interpret experimental studying of APs functional properties in cardiomyocytes by means of lab-on-chip technologies.

articleTitle: Formation of Silver Nanostructures in Different Surrounding Media via Photoreduction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In presented study, the synthesis of silver nanostructures in aqueous solution and Saccharomyces cerevisiae water extract by laser irradiation is described. Absorption spectra of the silver nanoparticles synthesized in two different surrounding media are obtained. The absorption spectra of synthesized in an aqueous solution nanoparticles after irradiation by red, green, and blue light are characterized by clearly pronounced two absorption peaks. The absorption spectra of synthesized in the yeast solution nanoparticles are characterized by one absorption peak. However, the position of these peaks is red-shifted in both cases. Thus, using different surrounding media for the silver nanoparticles synthesis by photostimulated reduction, one can obtain nanoparticles with the given shape and shift of their absorption peak to the desired spectral region.

articleTitle: Comparison Between PID and Fuzzy Regulator for Control Evaporator Plants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper, a comparison is made between FID and fuzzy controller. The purpose of the study is to determine when the use of which type of regulation will achieve the best indicators of quality control for the regulation of the evaporator. The regulation of such responsible parameters as levels of concentrated juice in the evaporator's buildings, which directly affect the quality and cost of manufactured products, is carried out. First, a mathematical model was developed in the space of states in the Matlab environment and results were obtained with respect to the variation of the problem relative to the initial conditions and with respect to perturbation. Secondly, a mathematical model with a PID-regulator was developed and transient processes for control circuits in all control channels were obtained. Thirdly, a mathematical model with a fuzzy controller was developed and transient processes for control circuits in all control channels were obtained. When comparing the mathematical model with PID and the fuzzy controller, it was concluded that the use of neuro-fuzzy regulation is more appropriate as it leads to an increase in the qualitative parameters of the process compared with the system with PID regulators.

articleTitle: The High-Voltage Electrical Engineering Systems of Gaseous Hydrocarbons Electro-Discharge Processing Design Principles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The design principles of high-voltage electro-technical systems for electro-discharge processing of gaseous hydrocarbons on the basis of high-frequency bipolar currents formation both with frequency-parametric regulation of the power source's current provided for ensuring its optimal value, and parametric regulation of the electro-discharge load voltage and restoration of its electrical resistance by changing the length of the inter-electrode gap. An experimental sample of the system constructed in accordance with the proposed principles was developed and tested. The built electro-technical system allows to stabilize the RMS value of the discharge current and to provide the given efficiency criteria. The dependences of specific energy losses and the coefficient of discharge current stabilization on the length of the inter-electrode gap are analyzed. The optimum value of the discharge current is determined.

articleTitle: Hydrogen Energy System Based on Silicon Nanopowders: Prospects and Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Hydrogen source and the model of hydrogen energy system based on chemical reaction of silicon nanopowders with water are described. The ways of hydrogen bonding and extraction are analyzed. The problems of general hydrogen output for porous powders, as well as the questions of hydrogen generation stability are discussed. The calculations determining intensity of the hydrogen generation and output electrical power are carried out. The prospects of application are investigated for the autonomous hydrogen energy system based on silicon nanopowders.

articleTitle: Optimization of Morphology of Nanocomposite Thin Film with Metallic Inclusions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The problem of optimization of morphology of nanocomposite thin films with spheroid metallic nanoinclusions was considered. The function of quadratic deviation from willing spectrum of absorption was used as target function. To optimize morphology of nanocomposite films, the pattern search was applied. The optimal morphologies of nanocomposite thin films were obtained. Theoretically optimized nanocomposite thin films effectively transmitted external light in all visible range.

articleTitle: Design of Low Leakage SRAM Bitcell
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: CMOS scaling affects to sub-threshold leakage, gate leakage and device variations growth leakage current. Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) cell is engaged the most area of Integrated Circuit (IC). It has been implemented FinFET bitcell, which leakage becomes the significant key factor in SRAM. In addition, proposed to implement 8T SRAM cell using diode connected NMOS/PMOS transistors to reduce leakage current. Different approaches were used for leakage reduction in the proposed circuit. Consequently, leakage power in the SRAM bitcell is reduced and runs better performance. The proposed SRAM bitcell showed an improvement of about 3 times leakage power over the 6T SRAM bitcell. Read and Write access times of the proposed SRAM bitcell increases about 18 %. Power also reduced about 10%. The proposed techniques of leakage reduction have been implemented by using Synopsys Armenia Educational Department's SAED 14 nm technology for FinFET SRAM.

articleTitle: System of Multi-Channel Ultrasonic and Radiometric Measurements for Determining Characteristics of Concentration Products
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The research suggests a method of controlling parameters of ore particles in the slurry flow by combining ultrasonic and radiometric measurements and the impact of high-energy ultrasound on ground ore particles in order to control their displacement into the measuring area.

articleTitle: Modeling of Wave Scattering by Multilayer System of Infinite Graphene Strip Gratings Using Integral Equations Combined with Operator Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: THz waves scattering by multilayer graphene strip grating is considered. The operator method is used. The solution of the key problem, the scattering problem by single infinite periodic graphene strip grating is obtained by the method of singular integral equations. The dependences of the reflectance, transmittance and absorbance are presented.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Using Phased or Timed Arrays in Audio Surveillance Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Array processing techniques are widely used in audio applications, especially in audio surveillance systems, where one of the tasks is the scan of the surroundings and the detection of acoustic sources. The array sensors sample the sound field in space, the same way an analog-to-digital converter samples sound in time. Correspondingly, the Nyquist criterion should be applied in the space domain in order to avoid aliasing artifacts. However, the audio spectrum is wide and reducing the sensor dimensions providing the correct reconstruction for all higher audio frequencies can be problematic. In this paper, we propose a comparative study on the usage of phased array solutions and the timed array counterpart.

articleTitle: Modeling a Convertor-class Interactive System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Modeling a convertor-class interactive system was performed for the conditions when resource-consuming technological processes are directly interconnected. The first stage deals with the substantiation of the necessity for the solution of the problem of determining the optimal trajectory of control. The synthesis of the structure providing the formation of the optimal trajectory of the control of the production structure under the conditions of a probabilistic character of the demand for its finished product is proposed at the second stage.

articleTitle: Resonant Properties of Electron Gas in n-InSb and Graphene Layers in Magnetic Fields for THz Multilayered Dielectric-Plasma-like Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The resonant linear and nonlinear properties in THz range of 3D electron gas in the layers of narrow-gap n-InSb semiconductor and 2D one in graphene placed into an external magnetic field are investigated. The linear resonant dependencies of the tensor complex conductivity are computed from the kinetic theory. When the electromagnetic frequency is close to the cyclotron one, the conductivity increases two orders and more. The dependencies of the tensor conductivity on frequency coincide with ones obtained from the hydrodynamic theory under realistic electron concentrations and collision frequencies. The same is valid for the nonlinear dependencies of the densities of electric current on the applied electric field in the presence of controlling external magnetic field, obtained firstly. Considered resonant electron gas layers will be suitable for nonlinear electromagnetic THz modulators on multilayered resonant structures containing such plasma-like layers and proper dielectric layers [1], with adding effective magnetc controlability.

articleTitle: Scattering and Absorption of the H-polarized Plane Wave of THz Range by a Circularly Curved Graphene Strip in the Free Space
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: We consider the scattering of an H-polarized plane wave by an infinite circularly curved graphene strip of arbitrary angular width, placed in the free space. Our analysis is based on the hypersingular integral equation for the current induced on the strip. Discretization of this equation is carried out by the Nystrom-type method that has a guaranteed convergence. This trusted computational instrument enables us to plot the dependences of the extinction cross-section (ECS) on the frequency, strip angular width and physical width, and its radius of curvature. We derive approximate equation for the resonance frequencies of the graphene plasmon modes and demonstrate its agreement with full-wave computations in the THz range.

articleTitle: Comparison of Composition and Temperature Dependencies of The Crystal Lattice Parameters for the Nd123’s Substitution Phases
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Nd123's substitution phases (Nd123) have been synthesized by citrate sol-gel method. A complex behavior of the crystal lattice parameters of Nd123's substitution phases as function of composition and temperature conditions of treatment were studied. It was shown, that the increasing of neodymium substitution degree in Nd123 solid solutions leads to the change of the crystal structure. It was clarified, that the tetragonal form of Nd123 solid solutions is stabilized by increasing Nd/Ba ratio (x is more than 0.1). The reflection broadening as function of composition was found for Nd123 solid solutions.

articleTitle: Challenges in Designing of an Optimal Time-Frequency Filter for the Non-Linear FM Signal Estimation and the Possible Solution
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Nonstationary linear frequency modulated (FM) noisy signals are efficiently estimated by using recently developed optimal (Wiener) time-frequency filtering solution. It is developed based on the estimation of instantaneous frequency (IF) of the filtered noisy signal and on its correspondence to the filter's region of support. Multiple-clock-cycle hardware design of this solution is firstly proposed, whereas the signal adaptive and the fully pipelined versions of the same solution, with the optimized time and hardware requirements and in their one-dimensional and two-dimensional forms, have also been recently developed. However, the non-liner FM signals cannot be ideally concentrated at their IFs and, hence, these signals cannot be efficiently estimated by using the IF estimation-based filtering solutions. Therefore, in this paper, challenges in estimation of the non-linear FM signals are analyzed in detail. Simultaneously, the consideration of the modified IF estimation-based algorithm suitable to provide high quality estimation of these signals is presented.

articleTitle: Improving Photoelectric Energy Conversion by structuring Si Surfaces with Ge Quantum Dots
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Structuring Si surfaces with Ge quantum dots can have a beneficial effect on the photovoltage (PV), increasing the PV magnitude and decay time. The origin of this behavior is intimately related to mechanical strains developed in the vicinity of the Ge/Si interface. The structuring is a promising means of avoiding the uncontrolled production of recombination centers and offering significant enhancement of the recombination lifetime due to carrier trapping in the dots. This work can open new opportunities for advanced photoelectric devices with recombination center free nanostructures.

articleTitle: Optical Properties of Carbon Films Obtained by Plasma-Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The series of diamond-like carbon films was fabricated using Plasma-Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD) setup designed for deposition of amorphous silicon films. The deposited films were analyzed in terms of optical properties. The limitations of the deposition parameters were found. The set of deposition parameters for carbon film deposition with suitable optical properties was proposed. It was established that by changing of the main PE-CVD parameters the DLC films having low and intermediate refractive indices may be obtained. In combination with high optical bandgap and low extinction coefficient it makes possible to apply the DLC films as antireflection and passivation layers for solar cells and IR optical elements.

articleTitle: Morphology of Composite Thin Films Filled With Luminescent Vanadate Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Thin films composed of vanadate nanoparticles incorporated in silicon matrices were applied by spin-coating and chemical drop evaporatin methods. Morphology of the films was studied using optical, atomic force and scanning electron microscopy. It was shown that films obtained from the same compositions but under different procedures have different morphology. Influence of procedure type on structure and luminescence characteristics of films has been discussed.

articleTitle: Near Fields of Twin Circular Silver Nanowires Excited by Electron Beam Moving between Them
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The optical diffraction radiation of harmonically modulated electron beam, which moves between twin circular silver nanowire scatterers is considered. The Coulomb electromagnetic field of such a two-dimensional beam is a surface wave propagating along its trajectory with the phase velocity equal to the beam velocity. This wave induces the currents on the nearby nanowires and hence a radiation occurs even if the beam does not cross the wire boundaries. If the wires are tuned to a resonance, the radiated power can display a peak proportional to the resonant mode Q-factor. Silver nanowires are famous as nanoresonators in the range of the visible light due to the surface-plasmon modes supported by sub-wavelength in radius wires. We compute the near field patterns of these optical resonators and analyze dependence of the radiation spectral characteristics on the wavelength and electron beam parameters. Our goal is to check how sensitive the near field pattern of such a scatterer is to the shift of the beam trajectory from the central-symmetric position. We find that this effect can be observable for a non-relativistic beam moving between a pair of sub-wavelength in radius silver nanowires.

articleTitle: Current Scaling of Multi-fin Devices in FinFET Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper studies the effects of high fin-numbers in FinFET devices, which have not been discussed before. The research has been conducted to address and explain the observed inconsistencies in FinFET technology nodes. The controlled variation of geometric parameters allows to control the drivability of a transistor. The deviations from the predicted equational definition are significant and must be considered during the design stage. There is a set limit for the maximum available fin number in transistors. The reason behind such a constraint is given. Simulation results of output characteristics and device maximum drivability are presented to verify the necessity of such limitation.

articleTitle: for Slotline’s Effective Dielectric Permittivity and Characteristic Impedance Computation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The method of solving the electromagnetic field problem of computing the characteristics of TE-modes of strip lines is proposed. The problem is reduced to the eigenvalues and eigenvectors problem, which is solved by the finite element method. The resulting solutions provide the possibility of obtaining the distribution of the component of the electromagnetic field and calculate the integral characteristics of the strip line, such as effective dielectric permittivity and characteristic impedance of the equivalent transmission line. The results of calculations for the slotline are presented, which are in good agreement with other published results. The proposed method has no restrictions on the geometric and electrophysical parameters of the lines and can be applied to any structures of striplines in an arbitrary medium.

articleTitle: Low-Jitter Phase-Locked Loop With Ring Voltage Controlled Oscillator Using a Prompt Phase-Error Compensation Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A ring-type voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) based phase-locked loop (PLL) is presented, with low jitter. Type-I and type-II PLLs cannot provide a low-jitter performance. Injection-locked clock multipliers (ILCM) were a good solution, but they could not have a high multiplication factor because of reference spur problem, and also their jitter performance was still not preferable as they do not have integrator of a VCO. ILCMs cannot correct drifts of free running frequencies. So the prompt phase error compensation technique (PPEC) is introduced, which prototype is the phase-realignment mechanism of ILCM. Proposed design can achieve higher multiplication factor, lower jitter for frequencies different from free-running frequency, due to ring VCO. The main idea of the PPEC technique is to almost fully remove the jitter, that has been accumulated during the previous period of the clock signal, in a short period of time, thus achieving low-jitter performance. Suggested design includes switch-loop filter (SLF) and the PPEC technique realization circuit. The flaw of increase in area and power consumption will be considered.

articleTitle: SOI p-MOS Biosensor Circuit-Layout Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper presents a new biosensor design for protein detection. An electric circuit is proposed on the basis results of technological and circuit-layout simulation of the biosensor. In this design, a capacitor, one side of which is a sensitive region, serially connected to the gate of the amplifier transistor. The simulation results show that the developed biosensor has a high sensitivity and linear dependence of the output voltage on the potential of the information signal.

articleTitle: Influence of Cobalt Substitution on Structural and Morphological Properties of Nanosized Lithium Ferrites, Obtained by Sol-Gel Auto-Ignition Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Li<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5-x/2</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5-x/2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> ferrite prepared by sol-gel auto-ignition, crystallizes in the spinel-type crystal structure (Fd3m). Investigated the effect of substituting cobalt ions in nanosized lithium ferrites. Based on X-ray, SEM and Mossbauer analysis, has been shown that the structure and morphology are sensitive to substitution, which is manifested in the change in the electrical properties of the investigated structures.

articleTitle: On the Formation of Field of Sound Intensity in the Shallow Sea Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The paper considers the mathematical and physical prerequisites for the emergence of local vortex structures of an intensity vector field of sound waves in a shallow sea, represented by a plane-parallel regular waveguide. The waveguide is insonified by a two-frequency source of harmonic type with small wave dimensions. As a result, the general possibility of the vortex regions formation of the intensity field in a water-filled waveguide with combined boundaries has been established, taking into account the peculiarities of applying the superposition principle for the sound field power flows under the conditions of a idealized two-frequency sound source.

articleTitle: Repulsive Interaction between Two Different-Sized Nanoparticles due to Self-consistency
