publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this work the prospects of analytical application of semiconductor nanocrystals synthesized using laser fragmentation method are discussed. The method of fluorescent CdSe nanoparticles synthesis using fragmentation of its powder suspension in dimethylformamide as well as optical properties of produced nanoparticles are described. The fragmentation method allows simple and efficient production of ultrasmall nanocrystals of high purity with unique properties that give good opportunity for using such structures as light emitting species in electrochemiluminescent analytical techniques and for biological imaging.

articleTitle: MOCVD Integration Technology of Enestor through Grafene-Like III-Nitride, Nanocarbides and InGaN/GaN QDs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The article studies integration technology aspect as for light emitting-conversion and energy storage part of enestor [1]-[3]. There have been considered non-lithographic templated InGaN/GaN QDs as its light emitting-conversion elements. We also discuss integration possibility of its energy storage part in a single process of MOCVD reactor as for sapphire nano-templates. It has been observed, that, on the nano-templated sapphire surface, a dense transparent film of anomalous surface resistance an order of magnitude lower compared to the original one may be formed. It was supposed to happen through clustering of the nanocarbides and consolidated phases of AlCN (or BCN) in the stream of trimethylaluminum (or triethylboron), respectively. It has been considered suitability of such sapphire nano-templates for super capacitor through formation of h-BN in which graphene can be encapsulated.

articleTitle: Object Spin Characteristics Restoration for Combined Tissue Areas in MRI
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The reconstruction of spin characteristics of the object with different types of tissues by magnetic resonance imaging methods is considered. Since the voxel is the important component of the reconstructed image quality in terms of spatial image resolution and signal-to-noise-ratio. For obtaining more pricise diagnostic information the one should take into consideration the combination of tissues within the single voxel. The obtained reconstructed spin characteristics for different voxel tissue ratio combinations by MRI methods let us reconstruction when using evaluation of spin characteristics of every single voxel of the object is supposed to obtain more informative diagnostic data in terms of reconstructed images quality.

articleTitle: Solid Solutions La1-xRxFeO3 (R = Pr, Nd, Gd) – Perspective Electronic Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In the present paper the phase composition and crystal structure of new mixed ferrites La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>FeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> (R = Pr, Nd, Gd) obtained by solid state reactions technique were investigated via laboratory and synchrotron X-ray powder diffraction techniques. It was established that all synthesized samples are crystallized in orthorhombic perovskite GdFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> type of structure. Unit cell parameters, coordinates and displacement parameters of atoms were obtained from the experimental X-ray diffraction patterns by full profile Rietveld refinement. The continuous solid solutions formation in the LaFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-RFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> systems (R = Pr, Nd, Gd) was proved by comparison of the unit cell dimensions of the mixed La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>FeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ferrites with the reference data for the parent LaFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and RFeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> compounds. The crossover of lattice parameters of La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>FeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> solid solutions was established at certain compositions along with the formation of dimensionally tetragonal (pseudo-tetragonal) structures.

articleTitle: Chemical Deposition of Thin Semiconductor CdS Films from Ammonia-Tiocarbamide Solutions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The process of chemical deposition of cadmium sulfide films from ammonia-thiocarbamide solutions is investigated. It is shown that the deposition is accompanied by a change in solution turbidity, while its dependence on the process duration makes it possible to identify areas of initial appearance of crystallization centers and continuous film formation. The study of the films obtained in sulfide-polysulfide electrolyte made it possible to establish that nanostructured CdS coatings have semiconducting properties. It is established that the photoelectric properties of samples increase significantly by both zinc and nickel sulfides addition to the coating composition and coatings annealing that allow improving the film morphology.

articleTitle: Infrared Spectra of Metal-Dielectric Nanostructured Phosphate Class Complexes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The infrared (IR) spectra of metal-dielectric nanostructured compounds of potassium titanate orthophosphate KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> (KTP) were studied in the range of (4000 - 50) cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. A group-theoretical analysis of the spectrum-generating elements of [PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>] and [TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>] groups under the influence of the field of position (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2v</sub>) symmetry and the intracrystalline field of the compound, respectively, was conducted. It is shown that changes in the optical properties of the compound elements are caused by breakdowns of their symmetry. The identification of the IR spectra of KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> was carried out in its approximation to the space symmetry group C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2v</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> with 8-formula units in the unit cell.

articleTitle: Development of an Intelligent System for Predicting the Reliability of Electric Motors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The uninterrupted operation of electric motors has the greatest impact on the operational reliability of the electrical engineering complex, on which the successful functioning of all the technological equipment of an enterprise, and as a result, the enterprise output, primarily depends. The article describes the development of a method of on-line intelligent diagnostics of electric motors which is based on a combination of statistical analysis of the operation of an electric motor over the period of operation and the current measurement of certain parameters of its operation. Using the analysis of statistical data obtained in production, the sensitivity of the predicted reliability of the selected input parameters of the predictive model was evaluated. The optimization of the number of incoming parameters is carried out using the genetic algorithm method, performs a large number of experiments with various combinations of input data. The article also describes the synthesis of a neural network, is the main part of an intelligent system for predicting the reliability of an electric motor. An intelligent system for predicting the reliability of an electric motor has been developed that will allow real-time detection of defects in electrical equipment and monitoring the condition of machines, thereby predicting the duration of their operation.

articleTitle: Many-To-Many Linear-Feedback Shift Model for Training of Artificial Neural Network in Dentistry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper, the authors consider how to label and save a large number of images that should be predict in a single file. Technique of automatic labeling the data set with finite element model for training of artificial neural network in tomography are proposed. Simple transparent example of sixteen images for predict in a single HDF5 file training of artificial neural network in tomography show accuracy 100% for training set as well for test set. Then this technique is able to build information model of salivary immune and periodontal status and to evaluate the correlation between salivary immunoglobulin level, inflammation in periodontal tissues and orthodontic pathology. The study was conducted on 139 subjects, which were in the age group of 12-18 years reporting to the Department of Pediatric Dentistry of Kharkiv National Medical University. The atopic group consisted of 103 patients with the following conditions: 76 patients of atopic diseases and gingivitis (Group 1) and 27 patients of atopic diseases, gingivitis and orthodontic pathology (Group 2). Among the 139 subjects, 36 healthy controls formed Group 3. The obtained data prove that there is an immune misbalance in children with atopy and in children with combined atopic and orthodontic pathology. Level of sIgA and IgG is decreased in group of patients with atopy and in group of children with atopic and orthodontic pathology. The information model of salivary immune and periodontal status was built and regression analysis showed that there was strong correlation between inflammation in periodontal tissues and level of immunoglobulins.

articleTitle: Modified Instantaneous Power Theory for Three-Phase Four-Wire Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: In this paper, the instantaneous power theory of three-phase four-wire power supply systems was further developed by substantiating new determination formulas for instantaneous active current, instantaneous apparent power and instantaneous power factor, considering the dependence from the ratio of transmission line resistances. The use of matrix-vector algebra formulas allowed to obtain a new decomposition of the load current of a three-phase four-wire system for instantaneous active current and compensation current, which is the theoretical basis for the construction of an active filtration system without electric energy storage with the minimum possible power losses in transmission line. A new decomposition of the squares of the instantaneous power modules is obtained, which corresponds to the specified current decomposition, as well as to the new formulas of the instantaneous apparent and vector imaginary power. The results of the computer experiment confirm the adequacy of the proposed new formulas of the modified instantaneous power theory.

articleTitle: Assessment of Electrocardiogram Quality Using Lossless Compression Technique for Heart Rate Variability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A simple method of assessment of electrocardiogram (ECG) quality based on lossless data compression is proposed. It is intended for a quick preliminary assessment of ECG in terms of further analysis of heart rate variability (HRV) based on a sequence of R-peaks. The method does not require a priori information about the type, nature and intensity of noise. The only output parameter of pre-processing step is the ECG compression ratio. Thresholds of compression ratio are determined, above which the results of further analysis of HRV are the same as for the corresponding ECG not distorted by noise. For a sampling frequency of 250 Hz, the threshold is equal to 1.4, for a frequency of 2000 Hz, it is 4.0. The results are shown for both synthetic ECG and ECG received using a personal screening diagnostic device.

articleTitle: Development and Studying Value of Method of Non-Invasive Pulsometry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Detail description of hardware and software of novel pulse-meter device - 4-channel photoplethysmograph CARDIOPULS has been presented. Above device is intended for noninvasive measurements of optical signals recorded from the pulse wave induced by the human heart. Hardware part includes 4 photometric channels, single- or 6 standard reference ECG channels, data processing unit, ECG electrodes, computer and software. Device can perform examination of the patients within 10-15 minutes at lying and sitting positions both in clinical environment and field location. Novel methods for data processing and device design were proposed. Device is aimed to diagnose of heart and vessel diseases.

articleTitle: Damping Optimum Design of Single-Phase Inverter Synchronization and Current Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: A design of current control system and grid synchronization algorithm is presented for a single-phase grid-tied inverter. A dual current controller is presented, wherein a proportional-resonant controller controls the principal component of output current, while a proportional-integral controller is used for inverter direct current component suppression. Grid voltage synchronization is based on a Modified Mixer Phase Detector Phase-Locked Loop algorithm with Second-Order Generalized Integrator for grid voltage orthogonalization and its subsequent normalization. Both current controllers and the synchronization algorithm are designed according to the damping optimum criterion. The effectiveness of the proposed inverter control and synchronization system is verified by means of comprehensive simulations.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Fire Intensity Based on Neural Networks in a Forest-Fire Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This work presents a method of fire intensity evaluation based on uncertain observations obtained by a forest fire monitoring system using jointly UAVs, remote sensing, and image processing. The proposed method uses two backpropagation neural networks to smoke and flame recognition. Flame color features, as well as dynamic shape/edge changing features, are trained using neural networks. Smoke and precipitation considered as the noise, various factors such as weather, light, features of sensors used in UAV were taken into account. The developed method provides sufficient performance to fulfill the requirements of credibility and efficiency.

articleTitle: Chemoresistive Response of Nanoporous Activated Carbon Fibers Upon Hydrofluorocarbons Treatment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The thermal resistivity method, which is a convenient and sensitive to electrical resistance changes, was proposed for control of chemical modification of nanoporous activated carbon fibers (NACF) with hydrofluorocarbons (HFC). The surface state changes could be monitored by measuring Ohmic resistance during heating, physisorption, and chemical reaction between the activated carbon material and HFC. Thus, we found a correlation between the fluorine content in the resulted carbon material and electrical resistance, measured from the room temperature to 900 °C. It was shown that in this way the temperature of the beginning of a chemical reaction and the temperature of the most effective chemical modification could be determined. The thermal grafting of fluororganic groups onto NACF is assumed to be the reason for the changed electrical resistivity of the initial NACF.

articleTitle: Fluorescent Probe for Investigation of Influence of Ribonucleosides With D–Mannitol
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: We have studied the interaction of ribonucleosides with D-mannitol and D-sorbitol using a fluorescent probe with fluorescent dye. Decreasing of intensity of fluorescence in solution during the titration of fluorescent dye with solutions of ribonucleosides (RN) and complexation of ribonucleosides with D-mannitol (RNM) were clearly observed. Fluorescence quenching in the RNM complex is less when compare with solution of ribonucleosides. We have shown these differences in spectral characteristics of ribonucleosides and complex RNM with a dye. The results may indicate the different interaction of D-mannitol with nucleosides. Such a different interaction is due to the structure of D-mannitol and D-sorbitol. Interaction is probably made with formation two hydrogen bonds between hydrogens of two parallel hydroxy (O-H) groups of D-mannitol and/or centers of hydrogen bonding in heterocyclic of nucleosides.

articleTitle: Piezoelectric Effect as Manifestation of Polar-Sensitive Bonds in Crystals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Piezoelectrics play an important role in the microelectronic devices. To describe their electromechanical properties the phenomenological theories usually used, in particular, crystallography. Nowadays the microscopic models also can have an important value in connection with beginning applications of piezoelectrics in the nanoelectronics. Proposed model is based on asymmetry in electronic density distribution along atomic bonds, which ensures the readiness of crystal to a polar (electrical) response onto non-electrical action. It is shown that difference between piezoelectrics and other polar crystals - pyroelectrics - is not fundamental, both properties can be explained by spatial distribution of polar-sensitive (mixed ionic-covalent) bonds, emerged as a result of compensation of atoms electronegativities.

articleTitle: Heat Transfer in Polar Crystals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: Thermal conductivity is very important technical parameter of electronics materials, which include polar crystals. Heat transfer in them is provided by short lattice waves with low velocity, so polar crystals looks like turbid medium. It was found that phonons interaction is determined polar-sensitive bonds, which is commensurable with crystal lattice parameter. Polar-sensitive (mixed ionic-covalent) bonds strongly affect the processes of heat transfer of crystals: their thermal conductivity is much less than that in the purely-ionic or purely-covalent crystals. Anomalies of thermal diffusion in the vicinity of ferroelectric phase transitions are also studied, when ordered polar structure spontaneously changes to disordered non-polar structure. In ordered phase the thermal diffusion coefficient increases; this fact indicates that disordering of polar-sensitive bonds hinders diffusion of heat.

articleTitle: Magnetic Memory in Antitumor Nanotherapeutics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: This paper demonstrates the basic principles and data obtained from experimental studies on the influence of a magnetic nanocomplex (MNC) comprising the antitumor drug doxorubicin and magnetic nanoparticles (NP) combined with simultaneous electromagnetic irradiation (EI) on cancer cell viability based on the magnetic memory effect. The key features of magneto-mechano-chemical synthesis were analyzed. The current investigation was inspired by a series of well-known studies on the role of free radical processes in tumor cell necrosis and apoptosis. The experiments carried out on A-549 human lung cancer cells have shown that nanocomplex (MNC2) with the saturation magnetic moment of 15.8 emu/g initiated a greater antitumor effect than MNC1 with the magnetic moment of 8.4 emu/g on an average of 27%.

articleTitle: Method of Ultrasonic Measurement of The Main Characteristics of Gas-Containing Ore Suspensions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 39th International Conference on Electronics and Nanotechnology (ELNANO)
abstract: The method allowing to determine the solid phase concentration and the content of crushed material particles of several size fractions is described. Description of the ultrasonic granulometer "Pulsar" construction, which implements the method of measuring the concentration of the solid phase and the particle size distribution of crushed material in the pulp is provided. The accuracy evaluation for the measurement of the pulp solid content and the content of the controlled size class was made by comparing the indications of granulometer with the results of carefully performed sieve analysis of samples. Based on the results of the sieve analysis of the selected samples, the cumulative (total) distribution curves of the size classes, as well as graphs of the distribution of the measurement points for the solid content and the content of the controlled size class in the pulp according to the granulometer and sieve analysis results were constructed.
